name: Tequila Old Fashioned
desc: The Camp Old Fashioned infusion kit steeped with aged tequila instead of bourbon, finished with a squeeze of lime.

source.title: Camp Craft Cocktails Old Fashioned Infusion Kit
source.evidence: The kit's own directions as reproduced by the retailer: add the spirit (tequila is listed), steep in the fridge 3 days, strain, and pour 1 1/2 oz over the biggest ice cube you can make.

ingredients.raw: 1 Camp Old Fashioned infusion kit (sugar, bitters, orange and cherry)
1 lime, cut into wedges, to serve

steps: Pour the tequila into the kit jar over the botanicals and stir gently. Blanco works, but aged tequila brings a warmth that suits the bitters and sugar.
Seal and refrigerate 3 days. The kit supplies the sugar and bitters, so nothing else goes in.
Strain out the botanicals into a clean jar or bottle and keep it in the fridge.

For each drink, pour 1 1/2 to 2 oz of the infused tequila over a large ice cube and add a small squeeze of lime. Tequila wants acidity in a way bourbon does not, and the lime brightens the whole drink.
tips: Once infused, drink it within 30 days. The kit can be refilled and infused a second time.
Camp's directions call for a 1 1/2 oz pour, which gets about 8 drinks from the jar; at 2 oz you get 6.

references.title: Camp Craft Cocktails Old Fashioned Infusion Kit
references.usedFor: 3 day fridge steep, pour size, 30 day shelf life, second infusion
